Name: CVA6-EnhancedSafe&Secure
Description: Explore pipeline enhancements in T2.1 (advanced scheduling, instructions reordering, branch prediction, address/data prediction, Multiscalar: from 2W to 3/4W) and implement the selected ones in T3.1 Multicore designs for safety/security.

Name: CVA6-SplitLockStep-DV
Description: Functional verification environment for a CVA6 dual-core split-lockstep automotive control processor configuration, targeted for safety-critical real-time applications with hypervisor support.

Name: IP-10M-MACsec
Description: Implement 10 megabit capable MACsec IP in accordance with IEEE 802.1AE.

Name: IP-Accelerator-Islands
Description: Hardware acceleration island, extended with the appropriate security and safety mechanisms to support design and run-time adaptive behavior (e.g., configurable hardware redundancy, lockstep, selective PQC and/or side-channel attack protection). CVA6, CV32E20 (with CV-X-IF).

Name: IP-CVA6-SplitLockStep
Description: Develop dual-core split-lockstep extensions for automotive control processor based on CVA6 (32-bit).

Name: IP-FastContextSwitchCVA6
Description: Implement IPs to enhance instruction-level parallelism, fast thread context switching, and multi-threaded execution in CVA6 pipeline (in cooperation with ST-IT).

Name: IP-FOC/MPC-Acc
Description: The primary scope of this IP covers the development of a proprietary RISC-V core modifications in terms of architectural features, instruction set extention and tightly coupled acceleratorfor for an efficient execution of FOC/MPC motor controll algorithms.

Name: IP-LowPowerMultiplator
Description: Implement and optimize low power IPs for tighlty coupled matrix vector multiplications for control automotive and high performance applicaitions.

Name: ML-AI-Acc-Cu#1
Description: Spatial array with all-digital near-memory processing for real-time I/Q baseband sample analysis. Integrated with PULP-based RISC-V core.

Name: ML-AI-Acc-Cu#5.1
Description: CGRA, float fixed point. Integrated with CVA6.

Name: ML-AI-Acc-VPU#6_FZI
Description: Multi-core VPU MultiVic. Older Version: https://github.com/MultiVic. Worker cores: CV32E40X Mgmt. Core: Ibex, Vector Core: Vicuna2: https://github.com/vproc/vicuna2_core

Name: IP-On-Chip-Communication
Description: IP blocks for on-chip communication and real-time shared scratchpad memory. The S4NOC network-on-chip.

Name: IP-RocketChip
Description: Safety-hardened flexible SoC-generator based on Chisel, with tracing capabilities.

Name: IP-Root-Of-Trust
Description: Implement a Root of Trust module which comprises features such as Secure Boot and Secure Storage.

Name: IP-RT-Monitor
Description: Implementation of a configurable Runtime Monitoring IP taking as input the processor trace and producing a stream containing the verdicts about the properties being checked.

Name: IP-rvhs
Description: Implementation of 4 way issue, high frequency out-of-order processor core

Name: IP-TimePredictableCVA6
Description: Implement and optimize IPs for time-predictability and time channel protection in CVA6-based processors, including spatio-temporal partitioning of TLB and LLC, ISA support for spatio-temporal partioning. CVA6, Other PULP IP

Name: IP-Virt-IPs-Ctrl-Proc
Description: IPs for safe and deterministic virtualization in automotive control processors (e.g., RISC-V hypervisor extension w/out virtual memory, SPMP for Hypervisor, etc.) integrated into CVA6 core.

Name: IPErrorDetectionCVA6
Description: Implement lockstep and error detection/correction in CVA6. Verified industrial superscalar CVA6 version targeting 50% CoreMark/MHz improvement CVA6 interconnect with peripherals

Name: Keccak-PQC
Description: Keccak accelerator with a focus on PQC algorithms

Name: ML-AI-Acc-Cu#2
Description: Systolic array int8, Planned to extend data types (e.g., bfloat16). FleXNNgine

Name: ML-AI-Acc-Cu#5.2
Description: Tighlty Coupled Near Memory Computing (NMC) Accelerator, reconfigurable. Integrated with CVA6.

Name: ML-AI-Acc-Cu#6_NION
Description: Sparse Aware Near-Memory Computing (NMC) Accelerator, spiking neuromorphic support.

Name: ML-AI-Acc-VPU#2
Description: Wide VPU compatible with BsC OoO Core, Digital, 22nm, 1.4GHz

Name: ML-AI-Acc-VPU#4
Description: Lightweight evaluation of VPU and NPU architectures for automotive AI workloads, focusing on performance–power trade-offs using high-level analytical models

Name: PQC-SWIP
Description: SW implementation of a PQC scheme participating in the ongoing NIST standardization effort using an AI accelerator to accelerator suitable arithmetic operations of the scheme. The implementation is hardened against timing attacks and single fault injection attacks.

Name: RV32-Compliance
Description: Assertion based library for RV32 ISA compliance checks. Primary use formal verification, secondarily simulation using compliance suite.

Name: S4NoC
Description: Time-predictable network-on-chip for message passing.

Name: VMEU
Description: Vector-Matrix-Extension-Unit

Name: Wildcat
Description: Another RISC-V core optimized for real-time systems.

Name: EA Message Engine
Description: Message infrastructure to transport trace and Debug data.

Name: EA Enhanced Trace Encoder
Description: The Enhanced Trace Encoder provides a mechanism to monitor CPU program execution in real time, encoding instruction execution and load/store activity in a highly compressed format for external reconstruction.

Name: EA JPAM
Description: The JPAM provides a bridge between the Tessent Embedded Analytics system and JTAG (IEEE1149.1), enabling control of JTAG TAP from Embedded Analytics messages for accessing processor debug interfaces.

Name: EA USB Communicator
Description: The USB 2.0 Communicator provides autonomous medium-speed communications between Embedded Analytics system and off-chip debugger via USB device or compound USB hub/device configuration.

Name: SoCMAKE
Description: SoCMake is a Risc-V based library for CMake that adds support for rapid hardware protottyping. It bridges the gap between software and hardware build flows, and allows for building complex System-on-Chip projects using a unified build system.

Name: PixESL
Description: PixESL, a virtual prototyping framework for pixel detectors based on C++/SystemC. It offers a platform for describing detector ASICs at a high level of abstraction.
